title: nav-recorder recorded event (one NDJSON line in .nav-recorder/raw/YYYY-MM-DD.ndjson)

requestHeaders.description: only authorization, cookie, content-type, accept, x-*

responseBodyRef.description: On disk only: sha1 of a body of 512+ chars stored once in the sibling .bodies.ndjson file; responseBody is null on that line and restored when read.

bodyError.description: response body could not be read (e.g. clone failed); status/headers are still valid

authSources.description: requestIds whose token/cookie this request carried (Layer 2b). Added by the host.

seq.description: monotonic per project, added by the host

transition.description: committed = full navigation; history = SPA pushState/replaceState

transitionType.description: chrome.webNavigation transitionType (link, typed, reload, auto_bookmark, ...). Absent on recordings made before interactions were recorded.

oneOf.description: A user interaction recorded by extension/interactions.js (capture phase, trusted events only). Navigation is attached at read time by the companion, not here.

role.description: explicit role attribute or the tag's implicit role

nameUnique.description: accessibleName + role single out this element (false when aria-label is reused as a class-like tag)

label.description: best human label: accessibleName when unique, else visible text

href.description: absolute href of the element or its closest <a href>

interactive.description: closest ancestor with a widget role when the clicked node has none

ancestors.description: up to 3 ancestors carrying a role or aria-label, nearest first

selectors.description: alternative selectors, most stable first: aria/Name[role=...], [data-testid=...], #id, css path, text/...

value.description: change events only; passwords are always "***"
